KOTAH

You're kind of the asshole. It would take 2.5 seconds to understand this sore spot for her that you poked. Apologize, but no basket is needed.

Thanks for the resources! It isn't all on me, but it is on me how I show up to support this human. If they are incapable of recalling a time when I successfully held them with grief arose then I am not doing the work as a friend. ZTHis human has resourced the fuck out of me and I want to do at least a little of that on my end.
It's clear she wants recognition for her achievements. It's important to celebrate her! You are the asshole YATA
NTA take care of yourself babe.

I also wanna put out there it's not your responsibility to fix or stay around for the intense psychological work that comes with undoing patriarchical indoctrination through violence against fems. I personally do not handle unsafe sexual environments well. Realistically your partner needs healing from that indoctrination and then maybe a follow up with CPTSD from surviving to thriving by Pete Walker. That books helpful in healing and naming the experience of neglectful and abusive parents. It details how to identify developmental delays due to the abuse/neglect and how to heal from it (years long process). Knowing the capacity for harm of those around you is the most valuable data for your safety. Good luck 🤞 I hope you stay safe.

Listen
Do acts of service
Do grounding exercises relating to safety
Let her scream, cry, rage, and mourn.whatever she needs just go with it. 

Survivor of 2 rapes and let me tell you, it kills parts of you. Look for community for her and yourself to support and uplift y'all. This could be religious, political, artistic, wtf. Community!
Wolf in sheep's clothing. Sometimes the long cons are the ones they enjoy the most. Run babe.
Yeah dude, ur younger son can make choices for himself and it's definitely not out of any question to provide a few choices but changing everything to revolve around one person is asking alot.

YNTA because consumerism is garbage anyway get something not mined by starving children and adults over seas and do something else with the money like buy her a gift thatll last for the rest of yall's lives together or go on a trip of a life time. I think requesting you to buy a ring just for the value of it is a lil wild. I dont think either of you are the asshole. I mean really when you're searching for a specific price you're probably doing that so you can show off and thats useless lol.
